author: v85_board_clarity (implementation author; self-test and rendered visual QA, not independent code review)

baseline_reproduction.command: PATH=<shared Python venv>:<Node24>:$PATH CDR_E2E_PORT=8188 npx playwright test --config <task scratch>/action/proof/playwright.config.mjs
baseline_reproduction.meaning: Two tests assert and demonstrate bad baseline behavior, not product acceptance.
findings: A committed winning guess with a lost 503 response leaves no result or score; retry returns 400 and still strands the UI.
A lost committed paid-clue response leaves the old clue button; natural retry spends a second clue.

native_runs.failures: Three historical source-shape checks pinned old handler windows, dependencies and HTTP400-only recovery. They were updated to require bounded handler regions, synchronous ownership, conditional pointer cleanup and the broader authoritative recovery. No application change was made to satisfy stale shapes.

native_runs.coverage_note: Includes all 177 inherited tests and 16 new actual controller behaviors. The final added case verifies an already different saved pointer pauses before any request.

final_build.coverage: TypeScript, Vite build and bundle budget passed. Root subsequently refreshed seed38 content only; application sources and built bytes remained frozen.

browser_runs.command: PATH=<shared Python venv>:<Node24>:$PATH CDR_E2E_PORT=8188 CDR_E2E_OUTPUT_DIR=<task scratch>/action/browser-initial-results npx playwright test e2e/contexto-action-recovery.spec.mjs
coverage: Lost committed winning response adopts server result, records once, clears only its pointer; reload does not double count.
Lost paid clue response restores first clue with one mutation and one GET, preserving paid counters.
Lost give-up response adopts terminal answer without a score or replay.
Failed verification persists beside input, disables mutations and allows only an explicit GET retry.
Failure before mutation commit restores exact counters, retains text and waits for an explicit later guess.
Late winning and missing GETs cannot adopt, score or clear another tab’s replacement round.
Exit invalidates a held recovery; a later screen/new pointer remains untouched.
An already different saved pointer blocks the old POST before any cost.
A verified owned missing session returns to setup and clears only its pointer.

screenshots/desktop-read-only-recovery.p.observation: Readable persistent notice and verification button beside retained input; mutation controls visibly disabled; browser assertion verifies notice is within the viewport.

screenshots/mobile-read-only-recovery.pn.observation: Readable persistent notice and verification button beside retained input; mutation controls visibly disabled; browser assertion verifies notice is within the viewport.

confirmed_invariants: No automatic mutation replay; one bounded active ticket, no accumulating client history.
No new API or session fields, no score changes, 7200-second sliding TTL, 1000 sessions/game and 64 KiB request limits unchanged.
Only server-confirmed terminal states reveal answers or supply scores.
Failed GET never falls back to stale state; changed pointer and stale operation cannot adopt or clear replacement state.
Preexisting saved-pointer change is detected before POST; explicit current-game load reuses saved-resume ownership checks.
limits: Browser faults replace or delay actual BFF responses; they do not claim backend idempotency or distributed exactly-once execution.
Mobile header HUD remains its existing horizontal strip; this change concerns recovery controls, whose viewport assertion and screenshot pass.
Root owns the full combined release matrix and independent code review; this receipt records focused author verification.
archive_note: Raw logs and proof script/config bytes are preserved losslessly using gzip mtime=0. log_sha256 binds decoded bytes and archive_sha256 binds the committed archive. Original files remain in task scratch.
